subject: Compact - Isolation claims & network artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@helio-sec.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueBank Security Team <audit@bluebank.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: condensed network claims for SIG pack

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. For our SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle we need a tight, single-page deliverable that maps your isolation claims to artifacts (diagram, routing table snapshot, and a short segmentation matrix). The reviewers at BlueBank want a version that they can hand to their audit team — compact is the key requirement (one page preferred, two max).

Can you provide: 
- one-page "isolation pocket" (PDF) that lists the claim, control owner, and artifact link
- a compact diagram (PNG) showing Dedicated vs Private demarcation and egress controls
- a brief mapping spreadsheet (CSV/XLS) we can load into our tracker

We have an internal deadline of Sep 24 for package finalization. If you can get something by EOD Sep 22 we can include it in the first pass.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Helio Security, External Audit

[No attachments]
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: condensed network claims for SIG pack

Kimberly / Jonas — forwarding Alyssa's ask. BlueBank wants a tiny deliverable that pairs the isolation claim language to actual artifacts. I want us to produce a minimal "pocket" bundle (PDF + PNG + XLS) we can reuse for other audits.

Proposed split of work:
- Kimberly: write the one-page pocket copy (claim lines + short remediation/owner notes). Keep language non-technical but precise.
- Jonas: produce a compact diagram that annotates Dedicated vs Private boundaries, routing/egress chokepoints, and a one-line note for fallback models. Export as 1200px PNG.
- I'll assemble the spreadsheet mapping (claim id, artifact filename/link, HubSpot doc id).

Constraints: no new detailed topologies — this is a high-level artifact. We must avoid embedding any customer IP. Use the existing v2 diagram as the base.

Target: attach to Alyssa by EOD Sep 22. Let me know blockers.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Solutions, Redwood Inference

[Forwarded message attached below]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: condensed network claims for SIG pack

Chloe / Jonas —

I drafted the one-pager and kept the tone audit-friendly. Highlights: claim phrasing that maps to SOC 2 section CC6.5 (logical and physical separation), short owner lines (Infra / Network / Platform SRE), and an "artifact index" linking to the diagram and segmentation matrix.

I've attached: rnw_network_pocket_v1.pdf (text-first, single-page) and controlplane-egress-summary.txt (two-paragraph callout on egress controls and KMS boundary).

Notes:
- I intentionally kept CIDR-level examples redacted and substituted pseudo-ranges for clarity.
- If Jonas can export the diagram with the new legend I can update the pocket PDF to reference the exact filename.

Attaching: 
- rnw_network_pocket_v1.pdf (attachment)
- controlplane-egress-summary.txt (attachment)

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rnw_network_pocket_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page); controlplane-egress-summary.txt (TXT, 2 paragraphs)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: condensed network claims for SIG pack

All — uploaded the compact diagram and created the segmentation matrix. Key callouts I added on the PNG:
- Dedicated pool boundary (labelled)
- Private/VPC demarcation with KMS sidecar icon near ingress/egress
- Explicit egress chokepoint showing permitted FQDNs and egress proxy flow

Attached: diagram-compact-v2.png (export 1200px) and segmentation_matrix_0626.xlsx (sheet has claim IDs and examples).

I also added a brief footnote in the spreadsheet clarifying that the "fallback model" uses a managed model variant in the hosted tier with automatic degrade-to-CPU flow.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Infra Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: diagram-compact-v2.png (PNG); segmentation_matrix_0626.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@helio-sec.com>
Cc: BlueBank Security Team <audit@bluebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T14:59:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: condensed network claims for SIG pack — artifacts attached

Alyssa — attaching the compact deliverables for the SIG bundle. Per your ask these are intentionally concise and reference the underlying artifacts rather than include detailed configs.

What you will find attached / linked:
- rnw_network_pocket_v1.pdf — single-page claim index (claim text, owner, artifact reference)
- diagram-compact-v2.png — compact Dedicated vs Private demarcation with egress callout
- segmentation_matrix_0626.xlsx — mapping sheet (claim id, artifact filename, short justification)
- controlplane-egress-summary.txt — two-paragraph egress/KMS boundary note

Related links (for your audit bundle):
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xy_example_drive_link
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/324512/deal/DB-4761

A few quick clarifications we anticipate from auditors:
1) CIDR and naming redactions — intentionally redacted; we can provide sanitized routing snapshots if BlueBank's legal team needs them.
2) Runtime failover — the pocket notes the fallback to hosted-managed model variants; the detailed runbook resides in the private repo and can be produced under an NDA.

If BlueBank needs any additional short clarifications we can do a 30-minute call next week.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rnw_network_pocket_v1.pdf; diagram-compact-v2.png; segmentation_matrix_0626.xlsx; controlplane-egress-summary.txt

Can you export the spreadsheet with both RNW and BB ids in the next revision? Otherwise the bundle looks good and we'll circulate to the audit team tomorrow.
